findings.finding: Cinnamon shows a window-could-not-be-opened notification although History is visibly open.
findings.acceptanceAssessment: Not evidence of a current UI failure: all matching queued warnings predate both W7 package rounds, and their source PIDs differ. Current UI is ready and exits normally; no driver kill precedes the frame. Coordinator accepted the retained-lab-state finding. The original cause of the older warnings is not attributed.
findings.displayedWarningCause: Cinnamon retained critical no-expiry notifications from earlier lab residents; extra post-use History activation reveals the old queue.
findings.exactStep: After revoke-additions and update.check, ui.show(view=history) precedes the pre-close frame; the same full sequence without this final activation shows no error toast.

activeLoadScope: Active process-family peaks are diagnostic with actual host loads retained. Every accepted idle sample is below one for all three host load averages, with no VM/build process, no swap and no helper.
